purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: City-specific Jining, Shandong registration and cadastral-map services are confirmed by the municipal bureau. The public route selects a parcel or building and returns address/location plus registration and rights-related attributes; the written notice also describes queries by specific address. No point, address, or parcel query was made, and no geometry endpoint with an allowlisted output was verified.
registryAssessment: Official Jining Natural Resources and Planning Bureau publications explicitly document city real-estate registration and a public cadastral-map visualization/lookup service. The queue point at 35.40986 N, 116.58646 E is Jining, Shandong (济宁市), not Jining/集宁 in Inner Mongolia. The advertised service reveals parcel location, unit/certificate numbers, rights, and encumbrance status; it is not a safe geometry-only endpoint.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Jining Natural Resources and Planning Bureau notice says public cadastral-zone/subzone information is available through Tianditu Shandong, and an address-specific registration lookup returns location, area, rights and encumbrance information. No address or parcel was queried.

Official municipal bureau describes its city real-estate registration and cadastral-map visualization, in which selecting a parcel/building can display property location, unit number, certificate number and other registration information. No selection was made.
Official bureau map-services page links to standard map services, Shandong geographic-information catalogue and Tianditu; it does not itself supply a geometry-only parcel feature endpoint.

Official Jining municipal government portal identifies the municipal jurisdiction and administration; the coordinates uniquely place this candidate at Jining in Shandong rather than Jining/集宁 in Inner Mongolia.
